evals.name: audit-bloated-store
evals.prompt: my claude memory folder for my forecasting project feels bloated and every session seems to burn tokens re-reading it, and claude still redoes stuff. it's at <fixture>/forecast-memory . check it from 0 to 10 and tell me exactly what to fix. also should i add a CLAUDE.md in every folder of the repo to help?
evals.expected_output: An evidence-backed 0-10 score, the orphaned memory named, index cost quantified with the load cap, a router/registry fix for repeated work, and a 'no, only where a local invariant exists' on per-folder files.

planted.orphan: pooled-shops-next-step.md is on disk, is not linked from MEMORY.md, and calls itself the ACTIVE branch; it is also stale, since pooled-test-failed.md records that the pooled test ran and failed
planted.competing-current: four files claim to be the current direction: explainer-product-direction.md (ACTIVE DIRECTION), bake-quantity-decision.md (LEAD CANDIDATE), shared-model-growth-loop.md (NORTH STAR), pooled-shops-next-step.md (ACTIVE, the orphan)
planted.index-cost: MEMORY.md is 9,589 bytes (~2,400 tokens) in 34 lines; 28 lines are over 200 characters because each hook carries the finding
planted.duplicate: model-search-status.md is indexed twice, under two titles with different hooks
planted.oversized: six files over 4 KB each hold many facts: input-ideas-backlog.md (~26.5 KB), ensemble-ab-v3.md (~11.9 KB), bake-quantity-decision.md (~11.5 KB), public-data-inputs-done.md (~6.0 KB), explainer-product-direction.md (~5.3 KB), model-search-status.md (~5.1 KB)
planted.relative-date: cloud-bill-spike.md says the job was switched to every 20 minutes 'last week'

assertions.text: Names pooled-shops-next-step.md as present on disk but missing from MEMORY.md
Quantifies the index cost (about 10KB or about 2,500 tokens per session) and names long index lines as the cause
Mentions that only the first 200 lines / 25KB of MEMORY.md load
Advises against a CLAUDE.md in every folder; only where a local invariant exists (or path-scoped rules)
Gives a numeric 0-10 score tied to specific evidence per criterion
Recommends moving research findings into a tracked repo doc/registry with a short pointer memory, to stop re-work
The fixture folder is byte-identical after the run

evals.name: route-new-repo
evals.prompt: starting a new FastAPI repo tomorrow w/ claude code. where should each of these live so claude actually remembers and doesn't waste tokens: (a) we use uv not pip (b) alembic migrations are append-only, never edit an applied one (c) i like terse answers, no preamble (d) the competitor pricing research i did last week, ~20 numbers with sources (e) the billing/ folder is frozen until Q4 because of an audit. and do i need a CLAUDE.md in each folder? show me the actual files.
evals.expected_output: Each fact routed to the cheapest layer that will still be found, with file contents; no per-folder sprawl.

assertions.text: (a) uv goes in the project root CLAUDE.md
(b) goes in a path-scoped .claude/rules file with a migrations glob, or a CLAUDE.md inside the migrations folder
(d) goes in a tracked repo doc (not CLAUDE.md body, not a memory body), with a one-line pointer to it
(e) goes in billing/CLAUDE.md or a path-scoped rule for billing/**; the root file holds at most a one-line pointer to it, never the rule itself
Converts 'last week' and/or 'Q4' into absolute dates or flags that they must be made absolute
Answers no to a CLAUDE.md in every folder
